description: For animations on a live website: opens the page in a headless Chrome or Edge and reads every animation exactly (CSS animations and transitions, Web Animations, Motion, and GSAP when the page exposes it): target, duration, delay, easing curve and keyframes, including ones triggered while scrolling; they are recorded from the first frame, so motion that ends while the page loads counts too. Also reads the real fonts, sizes and colours, takes views down the page, and films the opening motion frame by frame. Writes motion-spec.json and STYLE.md (all values `measured`), so `export` works on it. Needs Node 22+ and Chrome or Edge. For a page behind the user's own login, the user reads it in their browser with the Frame Lens extension ("Read this page's motion"); then pass `inbox` (the newest saved reading) or the path of the .framelens.json it saved, and the same files are written.

url.description: The page address (http or https); or `inbox`, or the path of a .framelens.json page reading saved by the Frame Lens browser extension.

name: web
title: Read a web page's animations
